summary: Implemented the window title feature without running tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title. rich/console.py adds set_window_title after show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal, returning True or False. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif that calls term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_control_title, test_set_window_title (skips the assertion on legacy Windows), and a Windows-only renderer test asserting set_title is called once with "Hello, world!". Verification was by reading only; Black formatting was not run.
